protocol.intervention: ALL starts, not only inward/failing cases; deterministic negative sum of CA-to-N/C/CB unit heavy bonds, original CA-HA length
protocol.invariants: same serialized System/integrator/State, all non-HA starting coordinates exact; HA must be unrestrained; all parameters/anchors/vrefs unchanged

protocol.physics: original no-solvent nonperiodic two native phases; only original positional weights divided10 in phase2
protocol.retention: raw states and all failures; timeout/budget nonexecutions separate; no resume/adoption or additional retries
protocol.source: ALL24 frozen starts; observed heavy source immutable before replay, generated GLN16 HA only may change
